questions.qtext: In persistent http connection after accessing objects from server by client, when does connection closes?

options.text: A separate http request has to send to close the connection.

questions.solution:

Once objects are accessed and no more objects are left, then timer is started and connection is closed for security reasons.

questions.qtext: In which scenario does a client send a request to port 80 but the actual http server or the machine listens on port 7000.

options.text: When the http server is directly bound to port 80.
When a reverse proxy listens on port 80 and forwards requests to port 7000.
When the client mistakenly connects to port 80 instead of port 7000.
When the server redirects all traffic to port 80 regardless of configuration.

questions.solution:
(b)
When the client wants to send any data to the server, the client should know the host name of public IP of server.
But for the protection of server, it will use cloud or internal private IP.
That’s the role of reverse proxy will start where the conversion of public IP to the private IP will happen.
questions.subject: Technical

questions.qtext:
In a reverse proxy set up where a client connects to port 80 and the proxy forwards the request to a backend server on port 50000, how many serial TCP connections are typically established? ________.

questions.solution:
2

One TCP connection from client to reverse proxy and another serial TCP connection from reverse proxy to backend server.

questions.qtext: Which of following is true in case of sockets of TCP?

options.text: When server has accepted the one client connection, then same server cannot accept further connections from different clients.
When server has accepted one client connection, then same server can accept further connections from different clients.
Listen( ) and accept( ) are the system calls at the server side.
Listen( ) and accept( ) are the system calls at the client side.

questions.solution:
(b, c)
Once a client is accepted, then the server can listen for further clients.

questions.qtext: Which module can analyze network layer header and validate it, when data is transmitted from source to destination?

options.text: The destination station’s Kernel at network layer.
Bridges at the data link layer.

questions.solution:
(a, b)
• Network layer Kernel at router will analyze the IP header and decrement TTL value.
• Network layer Kernel at destination will analyze protocol field and pass the data exactly to
TCP or UDP based on protocol field number.

Hub is a multiport device but not a two port device, repeater is a regenerative device but it is not an active device.

questions.qtext:
Consider a simple communication system where multiple nodes are connected by a shared broadcast medium (like ethernet of wireless).
The nodes in the system use the following carrier sense based medium access protocol.
A node that receives a packet to transmit will carrier sense the medium for 5 units of time.
If the node does not detect any other transmission in this duration, it starts transmitting it’s packet in the next time unit.
If the node detects another transmission, it waits until this other transmission finishes and then begins to carrier sense for 5 time units again.
Once they start to transmit nodes does not perform any collision detection and continue transmission even it a collision occurs.
All transmissions last for 20 units of time. Assume that the transmission signal travels at speed of 10 meters per unit time in medium.
Assume that the system has two nodes P and Q located at d distance a meters from each other. P
starts transmitting a packet at time t = 0 and begins to carrier sense the medium.
The maximum distance d (in meters, rounded to closest integer) that allows Q to successfully
avoid a collision between its proposed transmitted and P’s ongoing transmissions is ________.

NAT
questions.solution: 50
